summary: Kimberly-Clark filed an 8-K announcing exchange offers and consent solicitations tied to its previously disclosed November 2, 2025 merger agreement with Kenvue Inc., under which two Kimberly-Clark subsidiaries will merge into Kenvue in a sequential upstream structure. The company launched an offer to exchange any and all outstanding Kenvue notes for up to $7.0 billion aggregate principal of new Kimberly-Clark notes plus cash, alongside consents to strip restrictive covenants, default triggers, SEC reporting obligations and merger restrictions from the Kenvue indenture. The private offer is conditioned on deal completion. Watch merger closing and exchange-offer participation as the arbitrage pivot.
